source_en: You know what happened to my dog.
He came back through this checkpoint wrong. Something on your side of the glass touched him.
The poems were never mine. He moved through me. I was only ever the pen.
Petre, step away from the window.
In a moment. I am in the middle of something. He is. We are.
Your dog is alive. I've seen him.
You've seen what he is now. You did that. This place did that.
A pen doesn't grieve. I have. The next line is His, not mine.
